title: Played tracks
summary: The played-tracks list shows what aired, what was cut short, and what did not air because of a broadcast interruption, newest first.

entities.text: The track ran past the end of its segment and was faded out. It counts as aired, with its real duration.
The item was planned during an outage and did not reach the air. It stays here until you reschedule or dismiss it.
A period when the stream was interrupted, with the part that failed: Icecast, Liquidsoap, the backend, or the network.

usage: Choose a time range (up to 31 days) and, if you want, a status. Missed items carry a "Not aired" label; open them to reschedule them into a later hour or dismiss them. Times are shown in the station timezone.
steps: Choose the date range to look at.
Filter by status to see only missed items, if needed.
For a missed item, choose Reschedule or Dismiss.
Check the outage periods to see why items were missed.
mistakes: Expecting missed items to vanish after 10 days. Aired history is deleted after the retention period; missed items stay until you resolve them.
Reading times as your computer's time. All times are station time.

example.title: After an Icecast drop
example.text: Icecast was down from 14:05 to 14:12. The list shows two songs and the 14:10 news as Not aired. Reschedule the news to the start of the 16:00 hour and dismiss the two songs.

from.label: From
from.text: Start of the range, station time.

to.label: To
to.text: End of the range, at most 31 days after the start.

status.label: Status
status.text: Show only aired, truncated, or missed items. Empty shows all.
